paragraphs.source_en: In the late 1980s, Michael Eisner of Disney sent Robert Fitzpatrick to France to head up the new EuroDisney project, anticipating the realization of the European Union in 1992. Disney stock rose as a result of Eisner’s ability to think ahead. CalFed, too, prepared for what may be the largest single market on the planet.
